# #253 micro-fix — the ts-worker test gate goes green for the right reason

Bounded TS-only micro-fix on branch 241-final-message (worktree
.worktrees/241-final-message), commits atop 039226c29. Commit-as-you-go;
never push. This is a FRESH session; this brief is your complete charter —
do not infer scope beyond it.

## The defect (task #253, red already on the record)

The battery's ts-worker:test gate runs `bun test` in
sdks/typescript/aion-worker. One test fails under it:

    TypeError: vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync is not a function.
    (fail) reconnect > completes an unaborted default sleep and leaves
    no timer behind

Bun's vi shim lacks advanceTimersByTimeAsync; the SDK's package.json
declares vitest as its runner, so this suite has never fully run as the
gate executes it. The failure above IS the committed red — quote it in
the fix commit (it is also recorded at
gate-logs/241-remediation/ts-worker-stub-fix.log and in the
final-battery.log ts-worker:test section).

## Required work

Make the gate's OWN command (`bun test`, exactly as scripts/battery.sh
invokes it) pass the reconnect suite for the RIGHT reason:

- Rework the failing test's timer control to an API that is real under
  bun's runner (and still real under vitest if the declared runner is
  ever used) — the assertion's meaning must be preserved exactly: the
  unaborted default sleep completes AND no timer is left behind.
- FORBIDDEN: skipping/It.todo, weakening or removing the assertion,
  try/catch around the shim call, feature-detecting the API and
  silently no-oping, or adding a hand-rolled fake of vitest's API that
  fakes time without advancing the code under test.
- If you conclude the only honest fix is switching the gate to the
  declared vitest runner instead (a battery-script change, out of this
  brief's scope), STOP and say exactly that in your report — do not
  build it.

## Verification floor

- Pre-fix red quoted in the commit message (the failure above, at your
  own run).
- Post-fix: `bun test` full suite green (119 pass / 0 fail expected)
  AND `bun run typecheck` green AND `bun run check:proto` still green.
- Mutation honesty check: re-break the timer path (revert your test
  change locally) and confirm the failure returns, then restore —
  state this was done in the report.
- No production source edits; test file(s) only.

Work from the current repository state. Return only the value required
by the supplied output schema. Do not claim completion or verification
without direct evidence.
